summary.name: VS Runway AI
summary.one_liner: A paid web tool that turns one uploaded photo into a ~10-second vertical MP4 of you (or your pet) walking a glossy runway in giant feathered angel wings, with sound.
use_cases: Make a TikTok or Reels runway clip from a single selfie
Create a funny AI video of a pet walking a runway
Produce a short vertical fashion-show style video for social media
Try the viral angel-wing AI trend without editing software
summary.what_it_does: Users upload one photo and pick a look such as Dark Angel, Gold Wings or Pink Crystal, or a pet version. The tool generates a roughly 10-second 9:16 720p MP4 with runway music, crowd cheers and camera shutters. The clip follows four beats: a wave, a strut toward the camera, a zoom-in reach, and a blown kiss. Outfits are described as covered sequin gowns or suits with feathered wings, on a generic runway with no logos. Pricing is pay-once credit packs, with failed renders refunded automatically.
notable: One photo in, ~10s 9:16 MP4 with sound out, including pet looks
Pay-once credit packs with no subscription; failed renders return credits
Output uses a generic runway with no brand logos; site states it is an independent fan tool not affiliated with Victoria's Secret
caveats: Paid: from $8.88 for one 720p video (500 credits); larger packs $16.99 and $39.90
Adults 18+ only; users must have rights to the photos and label AI videos when shared
Renders take a few minutes and download links expire; results depend on photo quality (full body, front-facing works best)
